The '''Civic Spaceport''' was a small, public [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] servicing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
Built in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the civic spaceport was a public port which serviced citizens of the planet for their travel needs. The civic spaceport was located across from the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] and separated by the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]].<ref name="OITI" /> In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] proposed the expansion of the [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the floodplains below the city cliffs.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> This expansion took overflow and larger ships that the civic spaceport could not accommodate.<ref name="OITI" />
